module_summary: Sequential unsigned 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: a 5-bit step counter latches operands, then conditionally accumulates shifted multiplier into a 32-bit product register over 16 cycles.

anchors.name: i
anchors.why: Step counter sequencing load (0), accumulate (1-16) and done pulse (16/17).

anchors.name: yout_r
anchors.why: 32-bit product accumulator updated by shifted breg add; drives yout.

anchors.name: areg
anchors.why: Latched multiplicand; bit areg[i-1] gates each accumulate step.

anchors.name: breg
anchors.why: Latched multiplier operand, shifted and added into product.

anchors.name: done_r
anchors.why: Completion flag set at step 16, cleared at 17; drives done.

anchors.name: start
anchors.why: Level enable: runs counter and datapath while high, clears counter when low.

groups.name: step_control
groups.description: Step counter and done flag sequencing the multiplication.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand registers and shift-accumulate product register.
